messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — PR #8451 (kv-cache async flush) is green but blocked waiting on a second approver before the 13:00 PT merge window. Windows CI flaky but linux passed. @Maria can you take a look? :eyes:

Maria: On it, skimming now. can you paste the changelog snippet or main risk?

Alex: Main risk is kv cache eviction ordering when concurrent restore happens. Small reorder in flush path, added a unit test. Changelog: 'fix race on kv restore/flush causing stale keys'.

Sam: I can do infra-owner check — does this touch disk format or on-disk layout?

Alex: No disk format changes, just in-memory ordering. No migrations.

Taylor: pinging to confirm perf impact — bench shows no reg (added micro-bench in the PR).

Maria: Reading tests + diff. small nit on naming, but logic looks correct. I can approve once the nit is fixed. :+1:

Alex: pushed a tiny rename (force-pushed).

Maria: Verified new commit, running a quick local windows run now. If green I'll approve.

InfraBot: CI status: linux/amd64 ✅, linux/arm64 ✅, windows/amd64 ⚠️ (flake on test_kv_concurrency). Rerun queued.

Riley: I can help reproduce windows flake if needed — have a repro script.

Sam: thanks — if InfraBot clears and Maria approves, I can give infra-owner signoff in time for 13:00.

Maria: windows passed on rerun. Approving now. LGTM. :shipit:

Sam: infra-owner signoff from me. +1.

ReleaseSheriff: Noted — with 2x approval we'll auto-merge at 13:05 PT unless a blocker appears. Will monitor. :clock1:

Alex: Huge, thanks all. I'll watch the merge and smoke.

Taylor: quick follow-up — can we add that micro-bench snippet to the PR description so Optimize team can see perf numbers? Small suggestion post-merge if easier.

Alex: will add post-merge. Thanks!

ReleaseSheriff: merged at 13:06 PT, deploy pipeline started. CI smoke green. Closing thread.
